caption: The drawing depicts a narrow, elongated, fabric-like object that is wider at the top and tapers toward the bottom, held in the middle with a horizontal band resembling a clasp or ring that appears metallic and is colored gray. The object has alternating vertical stripes of green and gold/yellow, with each stripe displaying a segmented, beaded, or woven texture. The green stripes have a repetitive pattern with gaps or cross shapes in between, while the gold/yellow stripes bear a similar repetitive pattern. Below the clasp, the object continues with the same striped pattern, ending in a rounded point, where a small silver cone or cap attaches to a set of five dangling gray tassels or chains. The entire composition is centered on a plain, light beige or off-white background, with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Coin Purse
